question: Show the administrative department, academic department, maximum total units, subject title with maximum total units, average enrolled students, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, and the corresponding SIS subject code and subject code description for each administrative department and its corresponding academic department whose name is "Political Science" (Course 17), considering only subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, where the maximum total units is greater than 9, the department is degree granting, and the Mathematics department is excluded. Only include statistics for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mup.administrative_department, mup.academic_department, mup.max_total_units, mup.subject_title_with_max_units, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, mup.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MaxUnitsPoliticalScience mup JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON mup.academic_department = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND mup.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.administrative_department, icte.academic_department, icte.max_total_units, icte.subject_title_with_max_units, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.range_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For academic terms where the term status indicator is 'P', show the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the academic year, the term start date, the average academic year in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for the corresponding academic year, and the total number of unique departments offering subjects in those terms. gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the number of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects offered by that department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, and, for the Mathematics department in the current term (if the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10), the total number of subject enrollments, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments? List the department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total enrollments (for Mathematics) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MathEnrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, m.total_enrollments FROM DeptEnrolledStats d LEFT JOIN MathEnrollments m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ) SELECT DLC_NAME, avg_org_number, org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_org_number > ( SELECT AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered in regular academic terms, display each subject title, department name, total count of materials, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with at least one associated TIP material), the school name, and the department phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.material_count DESC;

question: For each building that has more than five rooms, show the building number and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, and for each room in that building with an access level of 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor, but only include those rooms whose area is greater than the average area for their building. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH BuildingAreaStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC ), RoomAccessLevel1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT bal.BUILDING_NUMBER, bal.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column, fr.AREA, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingAreaStddev bal JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON bal.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessLevel1 ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM ) , BuildingAvgArea AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.area_stddev, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.BUILDING_COMPONENT, i.FLOOR, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN BuildingAvgArea baa ON i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = baa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE i.AREA > baa.avg_area ORDER BY i.area_stddev DESC, i.FLOOR;

gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and for each department, provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department. Additionally, for each subject, include the subject description from the course catalog and the full department name from the department table. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, icte.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON icte.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

        SUBJECT_ID,
        SUBJECT_CODE,
        DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,

    WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
),

    SELECT
        s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS course_description_department_name,
        c.SUBJECT_CODE,
        c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
        d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
        ds.unit_range,
        ds.unit_variance,
        ds.unit_stddev
    FROM subject_summary AS s
    JOIN catalog AS c
        ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
    LEFT JOIN sis_course_description AS sc
        ON sc.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE
    LEFT JOIN sis_department AS d
        ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    LEFT JOIN dept_stats AS ds
        ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
      AND s.TOTAL_UNITS = 12
)
SELECT
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    course_description_department_name,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE

FROM result_rows;

    SELECT
        c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range,
        VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance,
        STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS c
    GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),

    SELECT
        c.SUBJECT_ID,
        c.SUBJECT_CODE,
        c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
        c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,

            PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_ID
            ORDER BY c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS c
)
SELECT
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS subject_dense_rank,
    du.units_range,
    du.units_variance,
    du.units_stddev,

    dep.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME

JOIN catalog AS c

   AND c.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN sis_course_description AS d
    ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE
LEFT JOIN sis_department AS dep
    ON dep.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN dept_units AS du
    ON du.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE

  AND s.TOTAL_UNITS = 12;

question: For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE', show the organization key, organization name, DLC name, and the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key, along with the space unit, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit and organization, considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'. The results should display the organization key, organization name, DLC name, rank, space unit, average HR department code, HR department code range, and HR department code variance, in that order. gold_sql: WITH org_ranked AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ), space_hr_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ) SELECT org_ranked.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_ranked.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_ranked.DLC_NAME, org_ranked.window_column, space_hr_stats.SPACE_UNIT, space_hr_stats.avg_hr_dept_code, space_hr_stats.hr_dept_code_range, space_hr_stats.hr_dept_code_variance FROM org_ranked LEFT JOIN space_hr_stats ON org_ranked.ORGANIZATION_NAME = space_hr_stats.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY org_ranked.DLC_NAME, org_ranked.window_column, space_hr_stats.hr_dept_code_range DESC

gold_sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.window_column

question: For each department and library material status among the top 5 departments with the highest average CIP program code for undergraduate courses, list the department name, library material status key, the number of subjects with at least 5 enrolled students in both the library and tip subject offerings, the average number of enrolled students in the library subject offered, the term code from the reserve material detail, the average CIP program code, the range and variance of CIP program codes, and the school name associated with the department. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and library material status. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS library_num_enrolled, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS tip_num_enrolled, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrd.TERM_CODE AS reserve_term_code, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, status_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, status, subject_count, avg_library_enrolled, reserve_term_code, dept_code FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY END AS status_sort, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, AVG(library_num_enrolled) AS avg_library_enrolled, MIN(reserve_term_code) AS reserve_term_code, OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, status_sort ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_cip_code, icte.cip_code_range, icte.cip_code_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.avg_cip_code DESC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT s1.department, s1.status, s1.subject_count, s1.avg_library_enrolled, s1.reserve_term_code, s2.avg_cip_code, s2.cip_code_range, s2.cip_code_variance, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.dept_code = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.department, s1.status;

base AS (
    SELECT
        d.DEPARTMENT AS dept,
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        d.SCHOOL_NAME,
        r.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
        r.TERM_CODE,
        l.SUBJECT_ID,
        l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail AS r
    JOIN library_subject_offered AS l
      ON l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = r.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
     AND l.TERM_CODE = r.TERM_CODE
    JOIN tip_subject_offered AS tip
      ON tip.SUBJECT_ID = r.SUBJECT_ID
     AND tip.TERM_CODE = r.TERM_CODE
    JOIN sis_course_description AS d
      ON d.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U'
     AND d.COURSE = l.SUBJECT_ID
    JOIN top5 AS t
      ON t.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT
    WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5
      AND tip.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5
    GROUP BY
        d.DEPARTMENT,
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        d.SCHOOL_NAME,
        r.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
        r.TERM_CODE,
        l.SUBJECT_ID,
        l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
),
ag AS (
    SELECT
        b.dept,
        b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        b.SCHOOL_NAME,
        b.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
        b.TERM_CODE,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count,
        AVG(b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled
    FROM base AS b
    GROUP BY
        b.dept,
        b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        b.SCHOOL_NAME,
        b.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
        b.TERM_CODE
),
outrows AS (
    SELECT
        ag.dept,
        ag.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        ag.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
        ag.subject_count,
        ag.avg_enrolled,
        ag.TERM_CODE,
        dc.avg_cip,
        dc.cip_range,
        dc.cip_variance,
        ag.SCHOOL_NAME,
        0 AS lvl
    FROM ag
    JOIN dept_cip AS dc ON dc.DEPARTMENT = ag.dept

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ag.dept,
        'SUBTOTAL',
        NULL,
        SUM(ag.subject_count),
        AVG(ag.avg_enrolled),
        NULL,
        MAX(dc.avg_cip),
        MAX(dc.cip_range),
        MAX(dc.cip_variance),
        MAX(ag.SCHOOL_NAME),
        1
    FROM ag
    JOIN dept_cip AS dc ON dc.DEPARTMENT = ag.dept
    GROUP BY ag.dept

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        NULL,
        'TOTAL',
        NULL,
        SUM(ag.subject_count),
        AVG(ag.avg_enrolled),
        NULL,
        AVG(dc.avg_cip),
        MAX(dc.cip_range),
        VARIANCE(dc.avg_cip),
        NULL,
        2
    FROM ag
    JOIN dept_cip AS dc ON dc.DEPARTMENT = ag.dept
)
SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    subject_count,
    avg_enrolled,
    TERM_CODE,
    avg_cip,
    cip_range,
    cip_variance,
    SCHOOL_NAME
FROM outrows
ORDER BY lvl, dept, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TERM_CODE;

raw.pred_sql:
WITH department_cip AS (
    SELECT
        so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
        so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        AVG(CAST(c.PROGRAM_CODE AS DECIMAL(20, 10))) AS avg_cip_program_code
    FROM subject_offered_summary AS so
    JOIN cip AS c
        ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = so.HGN_CODE
    WHERE so.HGN_CODE = 'U'
    GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
    ORDER BY avg_cip_program_code DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN GROUPING(d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
        WHEN GROUPING(lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
        ELSE d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
    END AS department_name,
    lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS library_material_status_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5
         AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5
        THEN lso.SUBJECT_ID
    END) AS subjects_with_at_least_5_enrolled_students_in_both_offerings,
    AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS average_enrolled_students_in_library_subject_offered,
    lrd.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    d.avg_cip_program_code AS average_cip_program_code,
    MAX(CAST(c.PROGRAM_CODE AS DECIMAL(20, 10)))
        - MIN(CAST(c.PROGRAM_CODE AS DECIMAL(20, 10))) AS cip_program_code_range,
    VARIANCE(CAST(c.PROGRAM_CODE AS DECIMAL(20, 10))) AS cip_program_code_variance,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name
FROM department_cip AS d
JOIN library_subject_offered AS lso
    ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail AS lrd
    ON lrd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered AS tso
    ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID
   AND tso.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN cip AS c
    ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN sis_department AS sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
GROUP BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
         lrd.TERM_CODE, d.avg_cip_program_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY department_name, library_material_status_key;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school name and department phone number. question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, provide the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the access level name, and the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms and assignable area greater than 0, with the access level name and variance matched to the access level of the rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.ACCESS_LEVEL ), AccessLevelVariance AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY num_rooms_variance DESC ) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, av.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, av.num_rooms_variance FROM RoomStats rs JOIN AccessLevelVariance av ON rs.ACCESS_LEVEL = av.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE

question: For each academic building (excluding those named "Ashdown House"), what is the building's full name, postal code, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, and for each organization (excluding organizations with IDs '138' and '250' and those named 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') associated with rooms in that building, what is the organization name and the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero? Show the building full name, postal code, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), organization name, and geometric mean, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH OrgGeometricMean AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), AcademicBuildingStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, abs.POSTAL_CODE, abs.coefficient_of_variation, ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean FROM AcademicBuildingStats abs JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION org ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN OrgGeometricMean ogm ON org.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ogm.geometric_mean DESC;

FROM fac_building AS fb

    ON rs.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN fac_building_address AS fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY

JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT

    FROM fac_rooms

JOIN org_codes AS oc
    ON oc.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY

  AND fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG <> 'Ashdown House';

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the minimum total units of its subjects (from SUBJECT_SUMMARY) in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following departments ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, inner_cte.Total_Courses, ss_min_units.min_total_units_window FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS min_total_units_window FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ) ss_min_units ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss_min_units.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE

gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectStddev AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ), SubjectWindow AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' ) SELECT sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.SUBJECT_ID, sw.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.window_column, ss.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectWindow sw JOIN SubjectStddev ss ON sw.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = so.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev

question: For each school, list its name, the number of degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the Mathematics department), and the maximum CIP program code among all courses in those departments, for schools that have at least one department with a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000. question: For each department that is not "Political Science" (Course 17), has a total number of units for courses in the "Engineering" or "Non-MIT" schools greater than 1000, grants degrees, and is not the Chemistry department (Course 5), list the department name, the total number of units, the average number of students enrolled in subjects offered by that department, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, and calculate the ratio of total units to average enrolled students rounded to two decimal places, ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.
gold_sql: WITH DeptUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000 ), DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.total_units, de.avg_enrolled, de.range_enrolled, de.var_enrolled, ROUND(du.total_units / NULLIF(de.avg_enrolled, 0), 2) AS units_per_avg_enrolled FROM DeptUnits du JOIN DeptEnrollment de ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_per_avg_enrolled DESC;

gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = t0.COURSE_NUMBER;

FROM subject_offered_summary AS s

question: For each school and each department within the school, provide the school name, department name, the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and for each academic year and subject in that department, give the academic year, academic year description, subject ID, total units, the department's average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in regular terms in that year, and the deviation of the subject's total units from the department's average in that year. Also include a grand total row for all departments in each school in the format of (school name, null, average, variance, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), SchoolDeptStats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sds.avg_units, sds.units_variance, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dys.SUBJECT_ID, dys.TOTAL_UNITS, dys.avg_total_units, dys.stddev_total_units, dys.deviation_from_avg FROM SchoolDeptStats sds JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats dys ON sds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dys.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.SUBJECT_ID ;

question: For the top 10 material statuses by number of materials, what are the corresponding library material statuses and their reserve catalog item counts for term code '2009SP'? List the material status, the material count, the library material status, and the reserve catalog item count, ordered by material count and then reserve catalog item count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH TopMaterialStatuses AS ( SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus AS ( SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC ) SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count FROM TopMaterialStatuses tms JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus lms ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count ORDER BY tms.material_count DESC, lms.reserve_count DESC;

question: For each subject title that is both offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department (with total units greater than 0 and not from the Chemistry department) and is a Mathematics subject offered in the term '2005FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, list the subject title, the variance of the record count for tip details associated with that subject, the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, and for each subject title, include a grand total of enrolled students in the format (subject title, null, null, null, null, total enrolled students).         ) AS record_count_variance,
        mathematics.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
        mathematics.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,

            ORDER BY q.SUBJECT_TITLE
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Political Science) that has at least one subject code associated with it, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, the school name, the department phone number, the average department budget code, the maximum range of department budget codes, and the average variance of department budget codes? gold_sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS range_dept_budget_code, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS var_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_dept_budget_code) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(ic.range_dept_budget_code) AS max_range_dept_budget_code, AVG(ic.var_dept_budget_code) AS avg_var_dept_budget_code, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_students, s1.stddev_num_students, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.max_range_dept_budget_code, s2.avg_var_dept_budget_code FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of Chemistry subjects with at least one enrolled student and at least one course material record, the average number of course materials per subject, the school name, and the department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avg_materials, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, AVG(num_course_materials) AS avg_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

        OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
        COUNT(*) AS subject_count,
        AVG(material_count) AS average_materials
    FROM subject_materials
    GROUP BY
        TERM_CODE,
        OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
        OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
),
rollup_rows AS (
    SELECT
        TERM_CODE,
        OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
        OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
        SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count,
        AVG(average_materials) AS average_materials,
        GROUPING(TERM_CODE) AS is_grand_total,
        GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS is_term_subtotal
    FROM department_term
    GROUP BY TERM_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP

SELECT

    r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,

LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department AS sad
    ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = r.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WHERE r.is_grand_total = 1
   OR r.is_term_subtotal = 1
   OR (r.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND r.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY r.TERM_CODE, r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: List all Mathematics subjects that are either (1) offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, showing the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, subject ID, and term code, or (2) offered in the academic year 2022 with at least one associated TIP material, showing the subject title, subject ID, term code, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term ordered by subject ID. gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;

WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y';

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry, Course 5), what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, and for each such department, also list the number of subjects offered and the average number of enrolled students per subject? Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2008%' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance

  d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  MIN(s.`TOTAL_UNITS`) AS `min_total_units`,
  MAX(s.`TOTAL_UNITS`) AS `max_total_units`,
  VARIANCE(s.`TOTAL_UNITS`) AS `variance_total_units`,
  COUNT(*) AS `number_of_subjects_offered`,
  AVG(s.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`) AS `average_enrolled_students_per_subject`
FROM `subject_offered_summary` AS s
JOIN `academic_terms` AS t
  ON t.`TERM_CODE` = s.`TERM_CODE`
JOIN `sis_department` AS d
  ON d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = s.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`
WHERE t.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` = '2008'
  AND d.`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` = 'Y'
  AND d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` <> 'Chemistry'
GROUP BY d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and are in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, and where the department's average total units of courses with more than 0 total units is greater than the overall average total units of all such courses in the school, show the course, course description, department name, school name, the rank of each course within its department ordered by course, the graduate level, and the department's average total units. List the results ordered by course. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.COURSE = scd.COURSE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.dept_avg_total_units, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.dept_avg_total_units > s.school_avg_total_units ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.dept_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT s1.COURSE, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.GRADUATE_LEVEL, s2.dept_avg_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.COURSE

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department's name, the range and variance of the number of students in each subject code offered by that department (considering only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name), the department's school name, whether the department is degree granting, the total number of graduate students in the department (where the department is degree granting and student year is 'G'), and indicate whether the department is a 'LARGE_GRAD_PROGRAM' (at least 20 graduate students), 'SMALL_GRAD_PROGRAM' (fewer than 5 graduate students), or 'MEDIUM_GRAD_PROGRAM' (otherwise). Present the columns in the following order: department name, subject count range, subject count variance, school name, is degree granting, total graduate students, and grad program size. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.subject_count_range, inner_cte1.subject_count_variance, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.total_graduate_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.total_graduate_students >= 20 THEN 'LARGE_GRAD_PROGRAM' WHEN inner_cte2.total_graduate_students < 5 THEN 'SMALL_GRAD_PROGRAM' ELSE 'MEDIUM_GRAD_PROGRAM' END AS grad_program_size FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.subject_count_range, cte1.subject_count_variance, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, cte2.total_graduate_students, cte2.grad_program_size FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.subject_count_range DESC;

WITH per_subject AS (
    SELECT
        ss.SUBJECT_ID,
        SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS student_count
    FROM subject_summary ss
    WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
      AND ss.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_ID
),
grad AS (

    FROM mit_student_directory

    d.SCHOOL_NAME AS `school name`,
    d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS `is degree granting`,
    grad.graduate_students AS `total graduate students`,
    CASE
        WHEN grad.graduate_students >= 20 THEN 'LARGE_GRAD_PROGRAM'
        WHEN grad.graduate_students < 5 THEN 'SMALL_GRAD_PROGRAM'
        ELSE 'MEDIUM_GRAD_PROGRAM'
    END AS `grad program size`
FROM sis_department d
CROSS JOIN grad
LEFT JOIN per_subject p ON TRUE
WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
GROUP BY
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    grad.graduate_students;

question: For each IPv4 subnet name that also has at least one DNS nameserver entry, return the subnet name along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of (1) the number of routes per subnet and (2) the number of IP allocation pools per subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH RouteStatsBySubnetName AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ), PoolStatsBySubnetNameWithDNS AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ( SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM subnets AS s2 JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id ) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC ) SELECT r.subnet_name, r.route_count_range, r.route_count_variance, r.route_count_stddev, p.pool_count_range, p.pool_count_variance, p.pool_count_stddev FROM RouteStatsBySubnetName AS r JOIN PoolStatsBySubnetNameWithDNS AS p ON p.subnet_name = r.subnet_name ORDER BY r.route_count_range DESC, p.pool_count_range DESC;

anr.action AS rbac_action, anr.target_tenant, anr.distinct_target_tenants, anr.window_column AS network_dense_rank, t.total_ipv4_subnets, t.has_any_updated_standard_attribute FROM active_network_rbac gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ), CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT soi.instance_uuid, soi.display_name AS shelved_display_name, soi.project_id, soi.power_state, soi.metadata_key, soi.metadata_value, soi.max_memory_mb_next_2, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS min_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following FROM ShelvedOffloadedInstances soi JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.uuid = soi.instance_uuid ORDER BY soi.instance_uuid) SELECT inner_cte.project_id, MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_mb_next_2) AS max_of_instance_max_memory_mb_next_2, MAX(inner_cte.min_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following) AS max_of_migration_min_memory_mb_window FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.project_id;

question: For each (VM state, display name) group that has more than 8 VCPUs per instance and whose instance count is greater than the average instance count across all such groups, show the VM state, display name, instance count, and minimum memory (MB); and for the matching 'forge' groups, also show the average deviation from the overall 'forge' average memory (MB) and the minimum 3-preceding/1-following windowed minimum memory (MB) computed over instance extra IDs. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), avg_mem AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_mem am ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT VM_STATE, DISPLAY_NAME, instance_count, min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE instance_count > (SELECT AVG(instance_count) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT s2.VM_STATE, s2.DISPLAY_NAME, s2.instance_count, s2.min_memory_mb, AVG(s1.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_among_forge_instances_in_group, MIN(s1.window_column) AS min_windowed_memory_mb_among_forge_instances_in_group FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s1.vm_state = s2.VM_STATE AND s2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY s2.VM_STATE, s2.DISPLAY_NAME, s2.instance_count, s2.min_memory_mb ORDER BY s2.instance_count DESC;

question: For each VM state, show the VM state, the average/range/variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value recorded in the instance extra table, along with the overall average of the per-VM-state average memory across all VM states. gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), NonDeletedInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name = 'forge') SELECT fi.instance_uuid, fi.display_name, fi.vm_state, ndi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id, fi.instance_extra_created_at, fi.network_info, fi.window_column AS min_instance_extra_id_window_3_preceding_1_following_by_memory, ndi.max_instance_extra_id_next2, ROUND(fi.instance_extra_id / NULLIF(ndi.max_instance_extra_id_next2, 0), 2) AS instance_extra_id_to_next2_max_ratio FROM ForgeInstances fi JOIN NonDeletedInstances ndi ON ndi.uuid = fi.instance_uuid ORDER BY instance_extra_id_to_next2_max_ratio DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.power_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(inner_cte.power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances, SUM(inner_cte.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, ROUND(AVG(inner_cte.instance_extra_id_to_next2_max_ratio), 2) AS avg_instance_extra_id_to_next2_max_ratio FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state WITH ROLLUP;

gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS ( SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000 ), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC ) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC ), AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol AS ( SELECT i.PROTOCOL, AVG(i.max_to_port * 1.0) AS avg_max_to_port FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.PROTOCOL ) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port, i.from_port_range, i.from_port_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol a ON a.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL WHERE i.max_to_port > ( SELECT a2.avg_max_to_port FROM AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol a2 WHERE a2.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL ) ORDER BY i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port DESC;

    WHERE sg.deleted = 0 AND sgr.deleted = 0

CROSS JOIN overall_average

question: For each active migration status (excluding accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed), show the status, the geometric mean of migrated instances’ memory (in MB) for migrations where instance memory is greater than zero, and also the instance-memory range (max minus min) and variance (in MB) for non-deleted migrations whose instances have a non-deleted instance info cache entry. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), MemoryRangeVarianceByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT g.status, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, r.memory_mb_range, r.memory_mb_variance FROM GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus g JOIN MemoryRangeVarianceByStatus r ON g.status = r.status ORDER BY r.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list the instance details (ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, hostname, VM state, power state, memory, vCPUs, availability zone) along with the related instance-info-cache record (ID and network info) and the per-project minimum memory (windowed by project), and also include (matched by VM state) the migration status summary for instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type' (migration status, migration count, and minimum instance memory). question: For completed migrations whose instance display name matches the pattern "flare", and restricting results to instances that are not deleted and are running on host "blaze8-12", show each migration’s id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory (MB), instance extra record id, the minimum instance memory (MB) in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of that instance’s memory (MB) across its system metadata rows. question: For completed migrations involving instances on host "blaze8-12", list each migration’s id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance VM state, and the maximum instance memory (MB) over a window ordered by migration id that includes the current row and the next 2 rows, but only for VM states that account for more than 10% of all completed migrations on "blaze8-12"; also include, per VM state, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining and the completed migration count. gold_sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), VMStateVariation AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), VMStateMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.dest_host, md.display_name, md.vm_state, md.max_memory_mb_next_2, vsv.coefficient_of_variation, vsmc.completed_migration_count FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN VMStateVariation AS vsv ON md.vm_state = vsv.vm_state JOIN VMStateMigrationCounts AS vsmc ON md.vm_state = vsmc.vm_state WHERE (vsmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(completed_migration_count) FROM VMStateMigrationCounts)) > 0.10 ORDER BY vsv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, md.migration_id;
